item.description:
# Splash Finish 0.3.15
- Snooze now keeps the panel hidden for its whole time. New events still land in the inbox and update the menu bar count; the panel opens with everything collected meanwhile when the snooze ends, when you show the inbox (Show Inbox, `⌥⌘S`, `splash-finish show`), or when the inbox becomes empty. Before, any new event ended the snooze. - ⌘C and ⌘V now work in pi question fields. - Splash Finish installs in `/Applications`, like the other bobuk.io apps. The standalone installer replaces and removes a copy that older installers put in `~/Applications`; without administrator rights, pass `--app-dir ~/Applications`. - The inbox panel, Settings, the `⌥⌘S` hotkey, Start at Login and the update flow now come from BobukKit 0.2.1, the shared bobuk.io component library.
Your inbox, settings and agent integrations are retained. Homebrew copies update with **Update Splash Finish via Homebrew…**; standalone copies update with **Check for Updates…**.
